player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee game Kuhn Poker ee {max_rounds} de round.
Gɛ̈ɛ̈r ee game:
- Kuhn Poker ee gɛ̈ɛ̈r ee dek ee 3 ee karton ee J, Q, K (J ee lo, K ee bär)
- Kɔɔ ee player ee ante {ante} ee chip ee näŋ ee 1 ee karton ee round ee dɛ̈ (kuɔ ee karton ee näŋ ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ, ee kɔɔ ee player ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ ee karton ee wɛ̈ɛ̈ ee opponent).
- Game ee dɛ̈ ee {max_rounds} ee round
- Player ee chip ee nɔ̈ŋ ee bär ee round ee dɛ̈ ee win
Gɛ̈ɛ̈r ee action:
- '[check]': Dɛ̈ ee bär ee bet ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ (ee kuɔ ee bet ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ ee table)
- '[bet]': Kuɛ̈ɛ̈ ee 1 ee chip ee pot ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ (ee kuɔ ee bet ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ ee table)
- '[call]': Kuɛ̈ɛ̈ ee opponent ee bet ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ ee 1 ee chip ee pot
- '[fold]': Wɛ̈ɛ̈ ee hand ee tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ ee opponent ee win ee pot

init_round.round_start: ### Kɛkɛ̈ cɔɔl {current_round} kɛ̈kɛ̈ thɛɛr {max_rounds} thɛɛr. Kaardiɛt cɛɛk eɛ: '{player_card}'

invalid_move.wrong_format: Cɛɛk aacɛɛk bɛ̈n ë̈ yɛ̈k: [Check], [Bet], [Call], kɛ̈ thɛɛr [Fold].

action.valid_actions: Kä lëu ba looi aa käkë: {legal_actions}.

showdown.showdown_summary: Kɔɔ̈ŋ ee kɔɔ̈ŋ: Player {winner} ee kaɣarɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ {winner_card} ee kɔɔ̈ŋ Player {loser} ee kaɣarɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ {loser_card}. Player {winner} ee kɔɔ̈ŋ chip {pot_value}.

outcome.draw: Në thök de {max_rounds} lɔ̈ɔ̈m, ke kɔc kedhiɛ aake ye naŋ kä thöŋ në kek yiic.
outcome.winner_player0: Raan ye 0 ke yen cï bɛ̈n tiaam në kë cenë chips juëc apɛi yök të thök {max_rounds} rune.
outcome.winner_player1: Raan ye 1 acï bɛ̈n tiaam në kë cï yen kä juëc apɛi yök të thökë {max_rounds} runkä ëbën.
